message:
The executor hit a TargetError mid-write: the migration stopped partway into the target (listmonk or brevo — the target is in the monitor tags). The engine is idempotent (diff + upserts), so the recovery is to fix the target-side cause and re-run `python -m executor.run --spec ... --execute`; a clean second run converges to zero writes. Always follow with `python -m executor.reconcile`.

RC1-548. @webhook-incident-summarizer
name: ESP migration — executor write errors
